gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic reads modern and businesslike, its rounded letters showing clear openings. Bellota Text opens its curves wide too, but every stroke carries the same weight, which gives the heading its own commanding look.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-figtree: No calligraphic shading anywhere: Bellota Text draws its open c, e, and s with a flat, commanding hand. Figtree follows in a contemporary plain sans that looks marker-drawn, its e leaving a wide gap at the terminal.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-finlandica: Clean and contemporary, Finlandica traces its outlines at a constant width, with e crossbars whose mouths stay open for the eye to enter. Bellota Text earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent tubing, modern and smooth, with a wide gap where each c finishes. And Bellota Text, commanding and shading-free, hands over to that plain sans body without any fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gayathri: Gayathri reads approachable, its curved letters all ending open and its strokes carrying a mild letterpress-slug swell. Gayathri's hairlines are present but never razor thin, while Bellota Text keeps crossbars as thick as its stems, so the two feel sturdy against soft.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable and professional, Gothic A1 flares its c terminal. Bellota Text brings its round letters with walls as heavy as the straight ones, a distinctive, commanding weight that the lighter sans body plays against.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open rather than curling them shut, contemporary and unfussy. And Bellota Text, drawn with one fixed nib width, hands off to a sans body that stays easy to keep reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads professional and approachable, each curve ending in a clean, open gap. And Bellota Text, with hairlines absent, feels like following a single thread, so the plain sans body keeps that smooth pull going.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: IBM Plex Sans Thai reads modern and crisp, the c's two ends pointing apart like open pincers. Bellota Text, with no hairlines at all, is distinctive and commanding up top, and that plain sans body settles things below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-inclusive-sans: Professional in feel, Bellota Text commands attention with open c, e, and s shapes and no calligraphic shading. Inclusive Sans does the quieter job, its round letters matching their stems and every curve ending open for sustained sans-serif reading.
